working_definition: A grouped call of prefollicle cells and stalk follicle cells in the whole-body 10x analysis of adult flies (Li et al. 2022, Fly Cell Atlas). Authors gave FBbt:00004910 stalk follicle cell and FBbt:00047835 prefollicle cell.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Somatic cell that is part of the ovariole. This does not include the ovarian sheath.

justification: Grouped call. Prefollicle cell (direct child of somatic cell of ovariole) is not a follicle cell, while stalk follicle cell is a follicle cell, itself under somatic cell of ovariole (verified via OLS ancestors). Somatic cell of ovariole is therefore the most specific common ancestor.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Cell that is part of the stalk connecting adjacent egg chambers in a vitellarium. Each stalk is usually composed of 5-8 interdigitating stalk follicle cells.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Group member; not a parent of prefollicle cell.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Somatic cell of the germarium that differentiates from a follicle stem cell and can differentiate into a follicle cell.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Group member; not a parent of stalk follicle cell.

recommendation: Map to somatic cell of ovariole (FBbt:00006030), broad match.
